bottom: A Bakuzis QC grid started from measured stand lists (PREREG44) does not clear 1.242 either, and its reported trajectories show that neither scalar gives a credible long run height path, which points 14.3 at the QC height increment form.
bakuzis: PREREG44 repeated the comparison from measured qc_c t1 stand lists (36 fold B stands stratified by ESI and stand density) instead of a seedling cohort, with Reineke evaluated only after a stand reaches half the QC frontier and site ordering tested on ESI bin means, and with the decision fixed in advance to inform 14.3 only. Every harness gate passed, including identity gates showing the driver edit left the earlier modes unchanged. The field tag anchor 1.242 did not clear: three new Reineke flags (worst margin 1.101 against 0.768), two new yield density flags and a larger worst top height fall (4.87 m against 1.04 m). The reported trajectories show why a scalar does not settle the question. From a mean measured top height of 14.49 m, 0.111 reaches only 17.29 m after 100 years (0.92 of ESI) and loses top height at some point in every stand, while 1.242 reaches 28.01 m (1.50 of ESI) and is still rising.
candidate: A Bakuzis grid from measured stand lists does not clear 1.242 for 14.3 either (PREREG44).
open_grid: - The QC height increment form for 14.3, since from measured stand lists 0.111 stalls top height and 1.242 lets it rise to 1.5 times ESI and still climbing at 100 years (PREREG44).
